About Me

Passionate Educator & Social Science Teacher

I am Aswathy R, a dedicated Social Science Teacher with experience in CBSE school environments. I specialize in delivering engaging, student-centered lessons in History, Geography, Civics, and Economics, making every class an active and meaningful experience.

"Education is not the filling of a pail, but the lighting of a fire."

Based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, I hold a Master of Arts in History and a Bachelor of Education from Kerala University. I am KTET and CTET qualified, and I am passionate about integrating digital tools, activity-based learning, and inclusive practices into the classroom every day.

Subjects I Teach

🏛️
History
Ancient civilizations to modern India — using primary sources, timelines, and story-driven learning to make history come alive for every learner.
🗺️
Geography
Physical and human geography with map-based activities, case studies, and environmental projects that build spatial awareness and global thinking.
⚖️
Civics & Political Science
Democratic values, constitutional rights, and governance — taught through debates, mock parliaments, and current affairs discussions.
📈
Economics
From basics of demand and supply to development economics, linking theory to real-world Indian economic events and student lived experiences.
🤝
Sociology
Social institutions, culture, inequality, and change — explored through case studies, field observations, and critical reflection on society.
🌍
Environmental Studies
Sustainability, ecology, and human-environment relationships — with a focus on local issues and global responsibility for future generations.
Teaching Philosophy

Four Pillars of My Practice

01
Student-Centered
Every lesson is designed around the student's experience. Learning is active, participatory, and meaningful — not passive memorization.
02
Activity-Based
I use hands-on activities, group discussions, and collaborative tasks to make Social Science concepts tangible and engaging for all learners.
03
Inclusive Classroom
Every student belongs. I adapt teaching methods to serve diverse learners and maintain positive, disciplined, and respectful learning environments.
04
Digital Integration
Smart classroom tools, Google Classroom, and multimedia resources are woven into daily teaching to enhance engagement and learning outcomes.

Classroom

Sample Lesson Approaches

01
Mock Parliament – Democracy in Action
Students form parties, draft bills, debate in legislative session. Brings Civics to life with role-play and real parliamentary procedure.
02
Map-Making Fieldwork – Local Geography
Students survey their local area, draw sketch maps, and compare to topographic sheets. Builds geographic skills rooted in their own community.
03
Oral History Project – Living Witnesses
Students interview elders about historical events. Combines primary source research, storytelling, and respect for community memory.
04
Economic Survey – Market & Village Study
Mini fieldwork where students collect data on local markets, analyze livelihood patterns, and present findings as research reports.
05
Debate Club – Current Affairs Forum
Weekly structured debates on social and political issues, teaching argument construction, evidence use, and respectful disagreement.
06
Documentary Analysis – History on Screen
Critically viewing documentaries and feature films for historical accuracy, bias, and narrative — building media literacy alongside content knowledge.
